################################################################################
# FRG Interactive: The Fake Russia Generator
#
# A Shinylive app for exploring social desirability bias assumptions.
# Users set assumptions about Russian society and see what survey data
# those assumptions would produce — compared to actual observations.
#
# Designed for embedding in the SDB report via Shinylive (browser-only).
################################################################################

library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)


##### LOAD BENCHMARK DATA #####

benchmarks <- readRDS("benchmark_data.rds")

# Observed benchmarks from VTsIOM Sputnik (2.9M obs, 2018-2024)
# Pre-war = 2021 + Jan 2022; Wartime = Mar 2022+
observed <- list(
  overall = c(pre = 0.660, war = 0.829),
  by_size = data.frame(
    size_label = c("Moscow/SPb", "1M+ cities", "100K-1M", "10K-100K", "Rural/small"),
    pre = c(0.587, 0.628, 0.659, 0.678, 0.729),
    war = c(0.713, 0.798, 0.834, 0.871, 0.901),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ),
  by_age = benchmarks$approval_by_age,
  dk_rates = benchmarks$dk_rates,
  svo = data.frame(
    source = c("Chronicles\n(online)", "Levada\n(F2F)", "FOM\n(F2F)",
               "VTsIOM\n(phone)", "Russian Field\n(phone)"),
    support = c(0.838, 0.801, 0.788, 0.784, 0.711),
    method = c("Online", "F2F", "F2F", "Phone", "Phone"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
)


##### FRG SIMULATION (3-GROUP, 2-PERIOD, WITH GEOGRAPHY) #####

run_frg_lite <- function(pct_believers, pct_apathetic, pct_opponents,
                          opp_lie_rate, apa_lie_rate, war_lie_boost,
                          dk_rate, apa_rally, opp_rally,
                          opp_refusal, apa_refusal,
                          seed = 42) {

  set.seed(seed)
  n <- 8000

  # --- Demographics ---
  age <- pmin(85, pmax(18, round(rnorm(n, 47, 17))))

  # Education (1-4)
  educ <- sample(1:4, n, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.10, 0.30, 0.30, 0.30))
  young <- age < 35
  old <- age > 55
  educ[young] <- sample(1:4, sum(young), replace = TRUE,
                         prob = c(0.05, 0.20, 0.35, 0.40))
  educ[old] <- sample(1:4, sum(old), replace = TRUE,
                       prob = c(0.15, 0.35, 0.30, 0.20))

  # Settlement size (1-5): Moscow/SPb, 1M+, 100K-1M, 10K-100K, Rural
  localsize <- sample(1:5, n, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.12, 0.23, 0.22, 0.24, 0.19))
  size_labels <- c("Moscow/SPb", "1M+ cities", "100K-1M", "10K-100K", "Rural/small")
  size_label <- size_labels[localsize]

  # --- Assign groups (demographic + geographic adjustments) ---
  # Moscow has more opponents; rural has more believers
  size_adj <- c(-0.06, -0.02, 0, 0.02, 0.05)[localsize]

  p_bel <- pct_believers + 0.002 * (age - 47) - 0.01 * (educ - 2.5) + size_adj
  p_opp <- pct_opponents - 0.002 * (age - 47) + 0.01 * (educ - 2.5) - size_adj
  p_apa <- 1 - p_bel - p_opp

  p_bel <- pmax(0.02, p_bel)
  p_opp <- pmax(0.02, p_opp)
  p_apa <- pmax(0.02, p_apa)
  p_total <- p_bel + p_opp + p_apa
  p_bel <- p_bel / p_total
  p_opp <- p_opp / p_total
  p_apa <- p_apa / p_total

  u <- runif(n)
  group <- character(n)
  group[u < p_bel] <- "believer"
  group[u >= p_bel & u < (p_bel + p_apa)] <- "apathetic"
  group[u >= (p_bel + p_apa)] <- "opponent"

  # --- True approval probabilities by group x period ---
  # Pre-war: base rates. Wartime: rally effects applied.
  approve_probs <- list(
    believer  = c(pre = 0.92, war = 0.96),
    apathetic = c(pre = 0.65, war = pmin(0.95, 0.65 + apa_rally)),
    opponent  = c(pre = 0.12, war = pmin(0.40, 0.12 + opp_rally))
  )

  # True SVO support by group (wartime only — no pre-war SVO question).
  # Lower than Putin approval for each group: the war is more concrete/divisive.
  svo_probs <- list(
    believer  = 0.82,
    apathetic = 0.45,
    opponent  = 0.06
  )

  # --- Period structure ---
  period_names <- c("Pre-war\n(2021-Jan 22)", "Wartime\n(Mar 22+)")

  # Per-group lie rates: pre-war vs wartime
  opp_lie <- c(pre = opp_lie_rate, war = pmin(0.95, opp_lie_rate + war_lie_boost))
  apa_lie <- c(pre = apa_lie_rate, war = pmin(0.95, apa_lie_rate + war_lie_boost * 0.7))

  # DK: slightly higher during war
  dk_rates <- c(pre = dk_rate, war = dk_rate * 1.25)

  # --- Simulate each period ---
  results <- data.frame()

  for (ix in 1:2) {

    idx <- sample(1:n, min(3000, n), replace = FALSE)
    grp_t <- group[idx]
    age_t <- age[idx]
    size_t <- size_label[idx]

    is_bel <- (grp_t == "believer")
    is_apa <- (grp_t == "apathetic")
    is_opp <- (grp_t == "opponent")

    # --- Selective non-response: refusers never enter the sample ---
    # Pre-war: everyone has ~same low refusal. Wartime: differential by group.
    if (ix == 1) {
      # Pre-war: uniform low refusal (~5%)
      refuse_prob <- rep(0.05, length(idx))
    } else {
      # Wartime: opponents and apathetics refuse at user-set rates
      refuse_prob <- rep(0.05, length(idx))
      refuse_prob[is_opp] <- opp_refusal
      refuse_prob[is_apa] <- apa_refusal
      refuse_prob[is_bel] <- 0.03  # believers rarely refuse
    }

    keep <- rbinom(length(idx), 1, 1 - refuse_prob) == 1
    idx <- idx[keep]
    grp_t <- grp_t[keep]
    age_t <- age_t[keep]
    size_t <- size_t[keep]
    is_bel <- is_bel[keep]
    is_apa <- is_apa[keep]
    is_opp <- is_opp[keep]

    # True approval
    true_prob <- ifelse(is_bel, approve_probs$believer[ix],
                  ifelse(is_apa, approve_probs$apathetic[ix],
                         approve_probs$opponent[ix]))
    true_approve <- rbinom(length(idx), 1, true_prob)

    # SDB: per-group lie rates
    measured_approve <- true_approve
    disapprove <- (true_approve == 0)

    flip_prob <- rep(0, length(idx))
    flip_prob[disapprove & is_opp] <- opp_lie[ix]
    flip_prob[disapprove & is_apa] <- apa_lie[ix]
    flip_prob[disapprove & is_bel] <- opp_lie[ix] * 0.15

    if (any(flip_prob > 0)) {
      flip <- rbinom(length(idx), 1, pmin(0.95, flip_prob))
      measured_approve[flip == 1] <- 1L
    }

    # DK
    dk_prob <- rep(dk_rates[ix], length(idx))
    dk_prob[is_apa] <- dk_rates[ix] * 1.8
    dk_prob[is_opp & disapprove] <- dk_rates[ix] * 1.5
    dk_prob[is_bel] <- dk_rates[ix] * 0.3

    dk_t <- rbinom(length(idx), 1, pmin(0.40, dk_prob))
    measured_approve[dk_t == 1] <- NA

    # --- SVO support (wartime only) ---
    # Same people, same falsification behavior, different true support rates.
    if (ix == 2) {
      svo_true_prob <- ifelse(is_bel, svo_probs$believer,
                        ifelse(is_apa, svo_probs$apathetic,
                               svo_probs$opponent))
      svo_true <- rbinom(length(idx), 1, svo_true_prob)

      svo_measured <- svo_true
      svo_disapprove <- (svo_true == 0)

      svo_flip_prob <- rep(0, length(idx))
      svo_flip_prob[svo_disapprove & is_opp] <- opp_lie[2]
      svo_flip_prob[svo_disapprove & is_apa] <- apa_lie[2]
      svo_flip_prob[svo_disapprove & is_bel] <- opp_lie[2] * 0.15

      if (any(svo_flip_prob > 0)) {
        svo_flip <- rbinom(length(idx), 1, pmin(0.95, svo_flip_prob))
        svo_measured[svo_flip == 1] <- 1L
      }

      # SVO-specific DK (higher than Putin approval DK — war is more sensitive)
      svo_dk_prob <- rep(dk_rates[2] * 1.5, length(idx))
      svo_dk_prob[is_apa] <- dk_rates[2] * 2.2
      svo_dk_prob[is_opp & svo_disapprove] <- dk_rates[2] * 2.0
      svo_dk_prob[is_bel] <- dk_rates[2] * 0.4

      svo_dk <- rbinom(length(idx), 1, pmin(0.50, svo_dk_prob))
      svo_measured[svo_dk == 1] <- NA
    } else {
      svo_true <- rep(NA_integer_, length(idx))
      svo_measured <- rep(NA_integer_, length(idx))
      svo_dk <- rep(NA_integer_, length(idx))
    }

    # Age group
    age_grp <- ifelse(age_t <= 29, "18-29",
                ifelse(age_t <= 44, "30-44",
                ifelse(age_t <= 59, "45-59", "60+")))

    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
      period = period_names[ix],
      period_num = ix,
      group = grp_t,
      age_group = age_grp,
      size_label = size_t,
      true_approve = true_approve,
      measured_approve = measured_approve,
      dk = dk_t,
      svo_true = svo_true,
      svo_measured = svo_measured,
      svo_dk = svo_dk,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }

  results$period <- factor(results$period, levels = period_names)
  results$size_label <- factor(results$size_label,
                                levels = c("Moscow/SPb", "1M+ cities", "100K-1M",
                                           "10K-100K", "Rural/small"))

  return(results)
}


##### PRESETS #####

presets <- list(
  "Levada defense" = list(believers = 35, apathetic = 45, opponents = 20,
                           opp_lie = 10, apa_lie = 3,
                           war_boost = 8, dk = 6,
                           apa_rally = 10, opp_rally = 3,
                           opp_refusal = 5, apa_refusal = 5),
  "Moderate skeptic" = list(believers = 25, apathetic = 40, opponents = 35,
                             opp_lie = 25, apa_lie = 8,
                             war_boost = 12, dk = 10,
                             apa_rally = 6, opp_rally = 2,
                             opp_refusal = 20, apa_refusal = 8),
  "Extreme skeptic" = list(believers = 15, apathetic = 35, opponents = 50,
                            opp_lie = 40, apa_lie = 15,
                            war_boost = 20, dk = 5,
                            apa_rally = 3, opp_rally = 1,
                            opp_refusal = 40, apa_refusal = 15),
  "Disengagement" = list(believers = 30, apathetic = 50, opponents = 20,
                          opp_lie = 5, apa_lie = 2,
                          war_boost = 3, dk = 15,
                          apa_rally = 8, opp_rally = 2,
                          opp_refusal = 10, apa_refusal = 10)
)


##### UI #####

ui <- fluidPage(

  tags$head(
    tags$style(HTML("
      body { font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif; max-width: 1400px;
             margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px; color: #2c2c2c;
             background-color: #ffffff; }
      .container-fluid { background-color: #ffffff; padding: 0; }
      .row { background-color: #ffffff; }
      .col-sm-3, .col-sm-9 { background-color: #ffffff; }
      h2 { font-size: 1.5rem; color: #1a1a1a; margin-top: 1.5rem; }
      h4 { font-size: 1.0rem; color: #1a1a1a; margin-bottom: 0.2rem; margin-top: 0.6rem; }
      .well { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #ddd; padding: 10px; }
      .shiny-input-container { margin-bottom: 3px; }
      .help-block { font-size: 0.75rem; color: #888; margin-top: -3px; margin-bottom: 4px; }
      .btn-preset { margin: 2px; font-size: 0.80rem; }
      .diagnostic { background: #f0f7ff; border-left: 3px solid #2166ac;
                     padding: 10px 14px; margin: 10px 0; font-size: 0.92rem; }
      .diagnostic-warning { background: #fff3cd; border-left: 3px solid #ffc107; }
      .diagnostic-good { background: #d4edda; border-left: 3px solid #28a745; }
    "))
  ),

  h2("The Fake Russia Generator: Putin Approval"),
  p("Build your version of Russia using the sliders: how many true believers, how much fear, ",
    "how much disengagement? The simulator runs a survey in your hypothetical Russia — ",

    tags$strong("orange"), " bars. The ", tags$strong("blue"), " bars show what real pollsters ",
    "(Levada, VTsIOM, FOM) actually measured. ",
    tags$em("Neither bar is 'the truth.' The question is: what assumptions about true attitudes ",
            "and bias can reproduce what pollsters actually found?")),

  fluidRow(

    # --- Left panel: inputs (narrower) ---
    column(3,
      wellPanel(
        h4("Presets"),
        actionButton("preset_levada", "Levada defense", class = "btn-sm btn-preset btn-info"),
        actionButton("preset_moderate", "Moderate skeptic", class = "btn-sm btn-preset btn-warning"),
        actionButton("preset_extreme", "Extreme skeptic", class = "btn-sm btn-preset btn-danger"),
        actionButton("preset_disengage", "Disengagement", class = "btn-sm btn-preset btn-success"),
        hr(),

        h4("What does Russia look like?"),

        sliderInput("pct_believers", "True believers",
                    min = 5, max = 90, value = 35, step = 1, post = "%"),
        helpText("Genuinely approve of Putin regardless."),

        sliderInput("pct_apathetic", "Apathetic middle",
                    min = 5, max = 90, value = 45, step = 1, post = "%"),
        helpText("Go along with whatever seems normal."),

        sliderInput("pct_opponents", "Genuine opponents",
                    min = 5, max = 90, value = 20, step = 1, post = "%"),
        helpText("Genuinely disapprove of Putin."),

        tags$div(style = "background: #eef; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px; margin-bottom: 6px; font-size: 0.85rem;",
          tags$strong(textOutput("group_sum_display"))
        ),

        hr(),
        h4("How much do people falsify?"),

        sliderInput("opp_lie", "Opponents who falsify",
                    min = 0, max = 70, value = 10, step = 1, post = "%"),
        helpText("Of opponents who disapprove of Putin, % who falsely say approve."),

        sliderInput("apa_lie", "Apathetics who falsify",
                    min = 0, max = 70, value = 3, step = 1, post = "%"),
        helpText("Of apathetics who disapprove, % who falsely say approve."),

        sliderInput("war_boost", "Wartime falsification boost",
                    min = 0, max = 50, value = 8, step = 1, post = "pp"),
        helpText("Extra falsification after Feb 2022."),

        hr(),
        h4("How does the war change minds?"),

        sliderInput("dk_rate", "DK / disengagement",
                    min = 2, max = 50, value = 8, step = 1, post = "%"),
        helpText("% who say 'don't know' instead of answering."),

        sliderInput("apa_rally", "Apathetic rally",
                    min = 0, max = 50, value = 10, step = 1, post = "pp"),
        helpText("How much apathetics' genuine Putin approval rises at war."),

        sliderInput("opp_rally", "Opponent rally",
                    min = 0, max = 50, value = 3, step = 1, post = "pp"),
        helpText("How much opponents' views shift at war."),

        hr(),
        h4("Who refuses to participate?"),

        sliderInput("opp_refusal", "Opponent non-response",
                    min = 0, max = 70, value = 5, step = 1, post = "%"),
        helpText("% of opponents who refuse surveys entirely during wartime."),

        sliderInput("apa_refusal", "Apathetic non-response",
                    min = 0, max = 50, value = 5, step = 1, post = "%"),
        helpText("% of apathetics who refuse during wartime.")

    ),

    # --- Right panel: outputs (wider) ---
    column(9,

      uiOutput("diagnostic"),

      fluidRow(
        column(6, plotOutput("plot_overall", height = "320px")),
        column(6, plotOutput("plot_size", height = "320px"))
      ),

      fluidRow(
        column(6, plotOutput("plot_age", height = "300px")),
        column(6, plotOutput("plot_dk", height = "300px"))
      ),

      tags$hr(style = "border-top: 3px solid #999; margin: 25px 0 15px;"),

      h3("War Support (SVO)", style = "color: #1a1a1a;"),
      p("Same people, same falsification behavior, applied to SVO support. ",
        "True SVO support is lower than Putin approval for each group ",
        "(opposing a specific war is more concrete than opposing a leader). ",
        "Your falsification sliders carry over.",
        style = "font-size: 0.92rem; color: #555; margin-bottom: 10px;"),

      fluidRow(
        column(6, plotOutput("plot_svo_sources", height = "320px")),
        column(6, plotOutput("plot_svo_breakdown", height = "320px"))
      )
    )
  )
)


##### SERVER #####

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  # --- Preset buttons ---
  apply_preset <- function(p) {
    updating(TRUE)
    updateSliderInput(session, "pct_believers", value = p$believers)
    updateSliderInput(session, "pct_apathetic", value = p$apathetic)
    updateSliderInput(session, "pct_opponents", value = p$opponents)
    updateSliderInput(session, "opp_lie", value = p$opp_lie)
    updateSliderInput(session, "apa_lie", value = p$apa_lie)
    updateSliderInput(session, "war_boost", value = p$war_boost)
    updateSliderInput(session, "dk_rate", value = p$dk)
    updateSliderInput(session, "apa_rally", value = p$apa_rally)
    updateSliderInput(session, "opp_rally", value = p$opp_rally)
    updateSliderInput(session, "opp_refusal", value = p$opp_refusal)
    updateSliderInput(session, "apa_refusal", value = p$apa_refusal)
    # Release lock after round-trip completes
    later::later(function() updating(FALSE), delay = 0.5)
  }

  observeEvent(input$preset_levada,    apply_preset(presets[["Levada defense"]]))
  observeEvent(input$preset_moderate,  apply_preset(presets[["Moderate skeptic"]]))
  observeEvent(input$preset_extreme,   apply_preset(presets[["Extreme skeptic"]]))
  observeEvent(input$preset_disengage, apply_preset(presets[["Disengagement"]]))

  # --- Constrained group sliders: always sum to 100 ---
  # When one slider moves, redistribute the difference to the other two proportionally.
  updating <- reactiveVal(FALSE)

  observeEvent(input$pct_believers, {
    if (updating()) return()
    updating(TRUE)
    bel <- input$pct_believers
    remainder <- 100 - bel
    old_apa <- input$pct_apathetic
    old_opp <- input$pct_opponents
    old_sum <- old_apa + old_opp
    if (old_sum > 0) {
      new_apa <- max(5, round(remainder * old_apa / old_sum))
      new_opp <- max(5, remainder - new_apa)
    } else {
      new_apa <- round(remainder / 2)
      new_opp <- remainder - new_apa
    }
    updateSliderInput(session, "pct_apathetic", value = new_apa)
    updateSliderInput(session, "pct_opponents", value = new_opp)
    updating(FALSE)
  }, ignoreInit = TRUE)

  observeEvent(input$pct_apathetic, {
    if (updating()) return()
    updating(TRUE)
    apa <- input$pct_apathetic
    remainder <- 100 - apa
    old_bel <- input$pct_believers
    old_opp <- input$pct_opponents
    old_sum <- old_bel + old_opp
    if (old_sum > 0) {
      new_bel <- max(5, round(remainder * old_bel / old_sum))
      new_opp <- max(5, remainder - new_bel)
    } else {
      new_bel <- round(remainder / 2)
      new_opp <- remainder - new_bel
    }
    updateSliderInput(session, "pct_believers", value = new_bel)
    updateSliderInput(session, "pct_opponents", value = new_opp)
    updating(FALSE)
  }, ignoreInit = TRUE)

  observeEvent(input$pct_opponents, {
    if (updating()) return()
    updating(TRUE)
    opp <- input$pct_opponents
    remainder <- 100 - opp
    old_bel <- input$pct_believers
    old_apa <- input$pct_apathetic
    old_sum <- old_bel + old_apa
    if (old_sum > 0) {
      new_bel <- max(5, round(remainder * old_bel / old_sum))
      new_apa <- max(5, remainder - new_bel)
    } else {
      new_bel <- round(remainder / 2)
      new_apa <- remainder - new_bel
    }
    updateSliderInput(session, "pct_believers", value = new_bel)
    updateSliderInput(session, "pct_apathetic", value = new_apa)
    updating(FALSE)
  }, ignoreInit = TRUE)

  output$group_sum_display <- renderText({
    total <- input$pct_believers + input$pct_apathetic + input$pct_opponents
    paste0("Total: ", total, "%")
  })

  # --- Run simulation ---
  sim_data <- reactive({
    run_frg_lite(
      pct_believers = input$pct_believers / 100,
      pct_apathetic = input$pct_apathetic / 100,
      pct_opponents = input$pct_opponents / 100,
      opp_lie_rate  = input$opp_lie / 100,
      apa_lie_rate  = input$apa_lie / 100,
      war_lie_boost = input$war_boost / 100,
      dk_rate       = input$dk_rate / 100,
      apa_rally     = input$apa_rally / 100,
      opp_rally     = input$opp_rally / 100,
      opp_refusal   = input$opp_refusal / 100,
      apa_refusal   = input$apa_refusal / 100
    )
  })

  # --- Shared theme ---
  theme_app <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 10),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      plot.margin = margin(6, 10, 6, 6)
    )

  fill_scale <- scale_fill_manual(values = c("Observed" = "#2166ac", "Simulated" = "#e08214"))

  # --- Diagnostic ---
  output$diagnostic <- renderUI({
    dat <- sim_data()

    war <- dat[dat$period_num == 2, ]
    pre <- dat[dat$period_num == 1, ]
    sim_war <- mean(war$measured_approve, na.rm = TRUE)
    sim_pre <- mean(pre$measured_approve, na.rm = TRUE)
    sim_true <- mean(war$true_approve)
    sim_dk <- mean(war$dk)

    # Sample composition: what share of wartime sample is each group?
    war_opp_share <- round(mean(war$group == "opponent") * 100)

    obs_war <- observed$overall["war"]
    obs_pre <- observed$overall["pre"]

    sdb_pp <- round((sim_war - sim_true) * 100, 1)
    gap <- abs(sim_war - obs_war) * 100

    # Non-response note
    nr_note <- ""
    if (input$opp_refusal > 10 || input$apa_refusal > 10) {
      nr_note <- paste0(" Opponents are ", war_opp_share,
                        "% of the wartime sample (vs ",
                        round(input$pct_opponents / (input$pct_believers + input$pct_apathetic + input$pct_opponents) * 100),
                        "% of the population) due to non-response.")
    }

    if (gap < 5) {
      css_class <- "diagnostic diagnostic-good"
      msg <- paste0(
        "<strong>Your assumptions produce plausible Putin approval data.</strong> ",
        "Pre-war: ", round(sim_pre * 100), "% (obs: ", round(obs_pre * 100), "%). ",
        "Wartime: ", round(sim_war * 100), "% (obs: ", round(obs_war * 100), "%). ",
        "True approval: ", round(sim_true * 100), "%. ",
        "Falsification: +", sdb_pp, "pp.", nr_note
      )
    } else if (sim_war < obs_war - 0.05) {
      css_class <- "diagnostic diagnostic-warning"
      msg <- paste0(
        "<strong>Your scenario undershoots observed wartime Putin approval.</strong> ",
        "Simulated: ", round(sim_war * 100), "% (obs: ", round(obs_war * 100), "%). ",
        "True: ", round(sim_true * 100), "%, falsification: +", sdb_pp, "pp. ",
        "Need more believers, larger rally, more falsification, or more non-response.", nr_note
      )
    } else {
      css_class <- "diagnostic diagnostic-warning"
      msg <- paste0(
        "<strong>Your scenario overshoots observed Putin approval.</strong> ",
        "Simulated: ", round(sim_war * 100), "% (obs: ", round(obs_war * 100), "%). ",
        "True: ", round(sim_true * 100), "%, falsification: +", sdb_pp, "pp.", nr_note
      )
    }

    tags$div(class = css_class, HTML(msg))
  })

  # --- Plot 1: Pre-war vs Wartime (overall) ---
  output$plot_overall <- renderPlot({
    dat <- sim_data()

    sim_vals <- aggregate(measured_approve ~ period, data = dat,
                          FUN = function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))

    plot_df <- data.frame(
      period = rep(c("Pre-war\n(2021-Jan 22)", "Wartime\n(Mar 22+)"), 2),
      approval = c(observed$overall["pre"], observed$overall["war"],
                   sim_vals$measured_approve[1], sim_vals$measured_approve[2]),
      source = rep(c("Observed", "Simulated"), each = 2),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    plot_df$period <- factor(plot_df$period,
                              levels = c("Pre-war\n(2021-Jan 22)", "Wartime\n(Mar 22+)"))

    ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = period, y = approval, fill = source)) +
      geom_col(position = "dodge", alpha = 0.9, width = 0.65) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                         limits = c(0.4, 1.0), oob = scales::squish) +
      fill_scale +
      labs(title = "Putin Approval: Pre-War vs Wartime",
           subtitle = "VTsIOM Sputnik benchmarks",
           x = NULL, y = "Putin approval", fill = NULL) +
      theme_app
  }, res = 96)

  # --- Plot 2: Wartime approval by settlement size ---
  output$plot_size <- renderPlot({
    dat <- sim_data()
    war <- dat[dat$period_num == 2, ]

    sim_size <- aggregate(measured_approve ~ size_label, data = war,
                          FUN = function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))
    names(sim_size)[2] <- "approval"
    sim_size$source <- "Simulated"

    obs_size <- data.frame(
      size_label = observed$by_size$size_label,
      approval = observed$by_size$war,
      source = "Observed",
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    combined <- rbind(sim_size, obs_size)
    combined$size_label <- factor(combined$size_label,
                                   levels = c("Moscow/SPb", "1M+ cities", "100K-1M",
                                              "10K-100K", "Rural/small"))

    ggplot(combined, aes(x = size_label, y = approval, fill = source)) +
      geom_col(position = "dodge", alpha = 0.9, width = 0.65) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                         limits = c(0.4, 1.0), oob = scales::squish) +
      fill_scale +
      labs(title = "Wartime Putin Approval by Settlement Size",
           subtitle = "Does your simulated Russia match the geographic gradient?",
           x = NULL, y = "Putin approval", fill = NULL) +
      theme_app +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9))
  }, res = 96)

  # --- Plot 3: Wartime approval by age group ---
  output$plot_age <- renderPlot({
    dat <- sim_data()
    war <- dat[dat$period_num == 2, ]

    sim_age <- aggregate(measured_approve ~ age_group, data = war,
                         FUN = function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))
    names(sim_age)[2] <- "approval"
    sim_age$source <- "Simulated"

    real_age <- observed$by_age[, c("age_group", "approval")]
    real_age$source <- "Observed"

    combined <- rbind(sim_age, real_age)
    combined$age_group <- factor(combined$age_group,
                                 levels = c("18-29", "30-44", "45-59", "60+"))

    ggplot(combined, aes(x = age_group, y = approval, fill = source)) +
      geom_col(position = "dodge", alpha = 0.9, width = 0.65) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                         limits = c(0.4, 1.0), oob = scales::squish) +
      fill_scale +
      labs(title = "Wartime Putin Approval by Age Group",
           subtitle = "Levada Courier benchmarks, 2010-2022",
           x = "Age group", y = "Putin approval", fill = NULL) +
      theme_app
  }, res = 96)

  # --- Plot 4: DK rates ---
  output$plot_dk <- renderPlot({
    dat <- sim_data()

    sim_dk_overall <- mean(dat$dk)

    dk_compare <- data.frame(
      variable = c("Simulated\n(overall)", benchmarks$dk_rates$variable),
      dk_rate = c(sim_dk_overall, benchmarks$dk_rates$dk_rate),
      source = c("Simulated", rep("Observed", nrow(benchmarks$dk_rates))),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    ggplot(dk_compare, aes(x = reorder(variable, dk_rate), y = dk_rate, fill = source)) +
      geom_col(alpha = 0.9, width = 0.55) +
      coord_flip() +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                         limits = c(0, NA)) +
      fill_scale +
      labs(title = "'Don't Know' Rates",
           subtitle = "Levada Courier benchmarks. DK varies by question.",
           x = NULL, y = "DK rate", fill = NULL) +
      theme_app
  }, res = 96)

  # --- Plot 5: SVO support — simulated vs survey sources ---
  output$plot_svo_sources <- renderPlot({
    dat <- sim_data()
    war <- dat[dat$period_num == 2, ]

    sim_svo <- mean(war$svo_measured, na.rm = TRUE)
    sim_svo_true <- mean(war$svo_true, na.rm = TRUE)

    plot_df <- data.frame(
      source = c("Your Russia", observed$svo$source),
      support = c(sim_svo, observed$svo$support),
      type = c("Simulated", rep("Observed", nrow(observed$svo))),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    plot_df$source <- factor(plot_df$source,
                              levels = c("Your Russia", observed$svo$source))

    ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = source, y = support, fill = type)) +
      geom_col(alpha = 0.9, width = 0.6) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = sim_svo_true, linetype = "dashed",
                 color = "#e08214", linewidth = 0.6) +
      annotate("text", x = 0.6, y = sim_svo_true + 0.02,
               label = paste0("True SVO support:\n", round(sim_svo_true * 100), "%"),
               hjust = 0, size = 3, color = "#e08214", fontface = "italic") +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                         limits = c(0.3, 1.0), oob = scales::squish) +
      fill_scale +
      labs(title = "SVO Support: Your Assumptions vs Survey Sources",
           subtitle = "Can your falsification assumptions match what each pollster finds?",
           x = NULL, y = "SVO support", fill = NULL) +
      theme_app +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9))
  }, res = 96)

  # --- Plot 6: SVO breakdown by group ---
  output$plot_svo_breakdown <- renderPlot({
    dat <- sim_data()
    war <- dat[dat$period_num == 2, ]

    # Compute: true support, falsified support, DK for each group
    breakdown <- data.frame()
    for (g in c("believer", "apathetic", "opponent")) {
      d <- war[war$group == g, ]
      n_g <- nrow(d)
      if (n_g == 0) next

      pct_true_support <- mean(d$svo_true, na.rm = TRUE)
      pct_measured_support <- mean(d$svo_measured, na.rm = TRUE)
      pct_dk <- mean(d$svo_dk, na.rm = TRUE)
      pct_falsified <- pct_measured_support - pct_true_support

      breakdown <- rbind(breakdown, data.frame(
        group = g,
        component = c("True SVO support", "Falsification", "DK / no answer"),
        value = c(pct_true_support,
                  max(0, pct_falsified),
                  pct_dk),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ))
    }

    breakdown$group <- factor(breakdown$group,
                               levels = c("believer", "apathetic", "opponent"),
                               labels = c("True\nbelievers", "Apathetic\nmiddle", "Genuine\nopponents"))
    breakdown$component <- factor(breakdown$component,
                                   levels = c("DK / no answer", "Falsification", "True SVO support"))

    ggplot(breakdown, aes(x = group, y = value, fill = component)) +
      geom_col(alpha = 0.9, width = 0.6) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                         limits = c(0, 1.15), oob = scales::squish) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("True SVO support" = "#2166ac",
                                    "Falsification" = "#e08214",
                                    "DK / no answer" = "#bbb")) +
      labs(title = "SVO Response Decomposition by Group",
           subtitle = "What's driving measured SVO support under your assumptions?",
           x = NULL, y = "Share of group", fill = NULL) +
      theme_app
  }, res = 96)
}
